creator: David Smith
mission: Sustainable generational wealth through reliable automation, genuine commercial value, preserved creative and scientific projects, and owner-controlled decisions.
change_rule: No approved or previously functioning capability may be silently removed, paused, downgraded, disabled, or renamed. Any intended subtraction requires a separately recorded explicit owner authorization, impact explanation, and rollback plan. These source checks report regression risk, not approval: only a separately verified owner-governed GitHub rule can prevent unauthorized merges.

capabilities.last_known_issue: Removed from public relay action allowlist during security hardening. Earlier owner reports described successful launches. Current cloud-to-HP launch must not be claimed operational.
capabilities.restore_requires: Owner-local explicit opt-in, narrow Notepad-only handler, interactive-session verification, successful HP receipt and regression test.

standing_owner_orders.instruction: Read the current public master from main before deciding; then reconcile accessible original chats, archives, project identity, event history and owner corrections. Do not claim inaccessible private sources were fully reviewed.
Keep original projects distinct, track parent/dependency links, events, mismatches, provenance and permissions; no silent capability subtraction and no private transcript dumps.
